knowledge:
- key_parameters: validCleavagePattern=Regular expression defining valid cleavage sites (e.g., "[KR]\\.[^P]" for trypsin) used in assess_termini to identify irregular cleavages ;; missedCleavagePattern=Regular expression defining missed cleavage sites (e.g., "[KR](?=[^P$])" for trypsin) used in assess_missed_cleavages ;; fdr.max=The maximum acceptable False Discovery Rate threshold (e.g., 0.01 for 1% FDR) used during filter optimization in optimize_filter ;; method=Optimization algorithm in optimize_filter, such as "Grid" for coarse search or "Nelder-Mead" for fine-tuning ;; level=The level at which FDR is evaluated or optimized ("PSM", "peptide", or "accession") ;; mod_mass=Mass of modification used to represent it in add_mod_symbol ;; symbol=Character symbol used to represent a modification in add_mod_symbol ;; extraction_pttrn=Regular expression used in remap_accessions and remap_fasta_entry_names to extract clean accession IDs from database headers
- alternatives: DeconMSn=Mentioned as a tool for accurate parent ion monoisotopic mass determination post-experimentally to avoid 1 Da errors, alternative to correct_peak_selection ;; DtaRefinery=Mentioned as a tool for post-experimental elimination of systematic mass measurement errors, alternative/precursor to recalibrate ;; IDPicker=Mentioned as the software whose method for calculating protein (accession) FDR is implemented in MSnID ;; MSnbase=Used for downstream quantitative analysis (spectral counting) and feature aggregation via MSnSet and combineFeatures, as MSnID does not perform quantification itself ;; msmsEDA, msmsTests, DESeq=Mentioned for downstream statistical analysis of spectral count data
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing bottom-up or top-down proteomics MS/MS search results (e.g., from MS-GF+, X!Tandem, SEQUEST) to control FDR, optimize filtering thresholds, and map modification sites (PTMs) to FASTA sequences.
- pitfalls: Search engines may consider off-by-one isotope errors (e.g., ±1 Da), causing mass measurement errors to stretch over 1000 ppm; users must correct this using correct_peak_selection or filter them out before recalibration ;; FDR increases when collapsing redundant PSMs to unique peptides or proteins; FDR must be re-evaluated at each level ("PSM", "peptide", "accession") ;; Accession IDs in MS/MS search results must match the FASTA entry names exactly for modification mapping; use remap_accessions and remap_fasta_entry_names to align them.

workflows.name: msms_filtering_and_fdr_optimization
workflows.intent: Load MS/MS search results, assess cleavage properties, correct mass errors, optimize filtering criteria to maximize identifications within a target FDR, and export to MSnSet.
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize MSnID object and load PSM data ;; 2. Assess cleavage termini and missed cleavages ;; 3. Calculate peptide length and other sequence properties ;; 4. Correct parent ion mass measurement errors and recalibrate ;; 5. Define filtering criteria and optimize thresholds using Grid and Nelder-Mead methods ;; 6. Apply optimized filters and remove decoy/contaminant matches ;; 7. Export to MSnSet for downstream spectral counting
workflows.code:
library("MSnID")
msnid <- MSnID(".")
PSMresults <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "human_brain.txt",
                                            package="MSnID"),
                                stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
psms(msnid) <- PSMresults
show(msnid)
mzids <- system.file("extdata", "c_elegans.mzid.gz", package="MSnID")
msnid <- read_mzIDs(msnid, mzids)
show(msnid)
msnid <- assess_termini(msnid, validCleavagePattern="[KR]\\.[^P]")
msnid <- assess_missed_cleavages(msnid, missedCleavagePattern="[KR](?=[^P$])")
msnid$numCys <- sapply(lapply(strsplit(msnid$peptide,''),'==','C'),sum)
msnid$PepLength <- nchar(msnid$peptide) - 4
msnid <- apply_filter(msnid, "numIrregCleavages == 0")
msnid <- apply_filter(msnid, "numMissCleavages <= 2")
msnid.fixed <- correct_peak_selection(msnid)
msnid.chopped <- apply_filter(msnid, "abs(mass_measurement_error(msnid)) < 20")
msnid <- recalibrate(msnid.chopped)
msnid$msmsScore <- -log10(msnid$`MS-GF:SpecEValue`)
msnid$absParentMassErrorPPM <- abs(mass_measurement_error(msnid))
filtObj <- MSnIDFilter(msnid)
filtObj$absParentMassErrorPPM <- list(comparison="<", threshold=10.0)
filtObj$msmsScore <- list(comparison=">", threshold=10.0)
show(filtObj)
evaluate_filter(msnid, filtObj, level="PSM")
evaluate_filter(msnid, filtObj, level="peptide")
evaluate_filter(msnid, filtObj, level="accession")
filtObj.grid <- optimize_filter(filtObj, msnid, fdr.max=0.01,
                                method="Grid", level="peptide",
                                n.iter=500)
show(filtObj.grid)
filtObj.nm <- optimize_filter(filtObj.grid, msnid, fdr.max=0.01,
                                method="Nelder-Mead", level="peptide",
                                n.iter=500)
show(filtObj.nm)
evaluate_filter(msnid, filtObj, level="peptide")
evaluate_filter(msnid, filtObj.nm, level="peptide")
msnid <- apply_filter(msnid, filtObj.nm)
show(msnid)
msnid <- apply_filter(msnid, "isDecoy == FALSE")
show(msnid)
msnid <- apply_filter(msnid, "!grepl('Contaminant',accession)")
show(msnid)
psm.df <- psms(msnid)
psm.dt <- as(msnid, "data.table")
peps <- peptides(msnid)
head(peps)
prots <- accessions(msnid)
head(prots)
prots <- proteins(msnid)
head(prots)
msnset <- as(msnid, "MSnSet")
library("MSnbase")
head(fData(msnset))
head(exprs(msnset))
msnset <- combineFeatures(msnset,
                            fData(msnset)$accession,
                            redundancy.handler="unique",
                            fun="sum",
                            cv=FALSE)
head(fData(msnset))
head(exprs(msnset))

workflows.name: handling_and_mapping_modifications
workflows.intent: Read modified peptide search results, encode modification masses with symbols, map modification sites to protein sequences, and remap accessions to gene symbols.
workflows.stages: 1. Load modified PSM data ;; 2. Report present modification masses ;; 3. Encode modifications with symbols (e.g., asterisk for phosphorylation) ;; 4. Map modification sites to FASTA sequences ;; 5. Remap accession IDs and FASTA entry names to gene symbols ;; 6. Re-map modification sites using updated gene symbols
workflows.code:
library(MSnID)
library(xtable)
library(dplyr)
library(Biostrings)
m <- MSnID(".")
mzids <- system.file("extdata","phospho.mzid.gz",package="MSnID")
m <- read_mzIDs(m, mzids)
report_mods(m)
m <- add_mod_symbol(m, mod_mass="79.966330925", symbol="*")
x <- psms(m) %>% 
    distinct(modification, peptide, peptide_mod)
m <- add_mod_symbol(m, mod_mass="229.1629", symbol="#")
m <- add_mod_symbol(m, mod_mass="57.021463735", symbol="^")
x <- psms(m) %>% 
    distinct(modification, peptide, peptide_mod)
fst_path <- system.file("extdata","for_phospho.fasta.gz",package="MSnID")
fst <- readAAStringSet(fst_path)
names(fst) <- sub("(^[^ ]*) .*$", "\1", names(fst))
m <- map_mod_sites(m, fst, 
                   accession_col = "accession", 
                   peptide_mod_col = "peptide_mod", 
                   mod_char = "*",
                   site_delimiter = "lower")
x <- psms(m) %>% 
  distinct(peptide_mod, SiteID)
conv_tab <- fetch_conversion_table("Homo sapiens", "UNIPROT", "SYMBOL")
head(conv_tab)
head(accessions(m))
m <- remap_accessions(m, conv_tab, extraction_pttrn = "\\|([^|-]+)(-\\d+)?\\|")
head(accessions(m))
fst_path <- system.file("extdata","for_phospho.fasta.gz",package="MSnID")
fst_path_2 <- remap_fasta_entry_names(fst_path, conv_tab, "\\|([^|-]+)(-\\d+)?\\|")
library(Biostrings)
readAAStringSet(fst_path)
readAAStringSet(fst_path_2)
fst <- readAAStringSet(fst_path_2)
m <- map_mod_sites(m, fst, 
                   accession_col = "accession", 
                   peptide_mod_col = "peptide_mod", 
                   mod_char = "*",
                   site_delimiter = "lower")
x <- psms(m) %>% 
  distinct(peptide_mod, SiteID)
